points.description: Names cetyl alcohol (hexadecanol / hexadecyl alcohol / 1-hexadecanol) as an evaporation inhibitor.
points.partial_credit: Half if only the general class 'fatty/long-chain alcohol' or 'hexadecane' is given, or the name is badly garbled.

points.description: Names stearyl alcohol (octadecanol / octadecyl alcohol / 1-octadecanol) as an evaporation inhibitor.
points.partial_credit: Half if only the general class 'fatty/long-chain alcohol' or 'octadecane' is given, or the name is badly garbled.

rubric.notes: Full marks (2) for naming both cetyl alcohol (hexadecanol) and stearyl alcohol (octadecanol); either the common name or the chemical name is accepted. Give 1 mark if only one is named correctly, or if both are only given as a vague class such as 'fatty alcohols' (half each). Give 0 for unrelated chemicals, such as salts, chlorine or oils.
